description: Source code for gain quantization functions used in AMR speech codec, including MR795_gain_code_quant3, MR795_gain_code_quant_mod, and MR795_gain_quant, with related helper functions and external references.

methods.name: MR795_gain_code_quant3

methods.name: MR795_gain_code_quant_mod
